title: Kaysender: 5th edition D&D campaign Info
author: Christopher Vardeman
policy: The wiki is the canonical hard-reference corpus. Every source section should become a wiki entry or indexed source chunk before downstream generators and editors derive from it.
ingestionRules: Do not replace source material with short summaries.
Do not use editor convenience as the reason to omit lore.
Every wiki entry should carry sourceRefs once its source pages are known.
If an entry is incomplete, mark it partial-source or seed-summary instead of presenting it as complete.
Legacy rules/mechanics text should be indexed but clearly marked mechanics-legacy or conversion-note where appropriate.
Generators must derive from wiki entries and source chunks, not from memory-compressed summaries.

sourceStatusDefinitions.seed-summary: A placeholder or compressed seed. Not enough for generator derivation.
sourceStatusDefinitions.partial-source: Some source lore has been incorporated, but the source section is not yet fully preserved.
sourceStatusDefinitions.source-faithful: The entry preserves the lore substance of the referenced source section in reader-facing form.
sourceStatusDefinitions.full-source-import: The complete source section has been migrated into wiki/source chunks and cross-linked.
sourceStatusDefinitions.derived-tool-output: Generated by an editor or generator and not itself a canonical source entry.

currentSourcePacks.description: First correction pass replacing editor-heavy visible wiki entries with reader-facing source lore for the opening world material, peoples, Messara, Valeria, and Black Fleet.

requiredNextPasses.scope: Fully import remaining Messara nation entries: Faelenor, Teralon, Silvalis, Vornak, Rylune, Zarovar, Eldrath, Imbria, and national capitals.
Import named locations, settlements, capitals, skyports, ruins, wilderness areas, and regional geography from the manuscript.
Import factions, guilds, pirate groups, criminal groups, trade organizations, religious powers, and resistance groups as lore-first entries.
Import airship construction, core manufacture, gear, alchemy, potions, weather equipment, tools, and market goods.
Import creatures, diseases, sky ecology, materials, valuable creature products, and environmental hazards.
Index legacy fifth-edition mechanical material separately as mechanics-legacy and conversion-note entries so it is preserved but not confused with Hypertext d20-compatible rules text.
